notes: Published facts with no cat6 or compat2 field, kept verbatim rather than dropped; all from source.cat6.gigabyte.b650-aorus-elite-ax-v2.spec. Memory: 4 DIMM sockets, maximum capacity 256GB. maxMemorySpeedMtS records DDR5-8000(OC), the highest rate the vendor explicitly lists for this SKU, per C14 -- a catalog compatibility ceiling, not a guarantee that any given kit, CPU memory controller or DIMM population reaches it. BIOS: biosMinVersionForCpu is deliberately empty under O6; this catalog does not model BIOS-revision compatibility, and checkChipsetBios reports that as unavailable. The page also separates the Wi-Fi module by PCB rev. 1.0 / 1.1; the catalogued identity is the B650 AORUS ELITE AX V2 model itself, and no PCB revision is added to identity because no recorded field depends on the difference.
